verified_facts: all_state_current scans all Listing identities, including invisible/unmatched rows, for missing/current-version state.
_state_page skips global census when dirty nonempty, evaluates unknown natively and only then constructs final population.
Candidates excludes nonpublished/nonapproved/expired before additional filters; aggregate over candidates cannot replace global census.
decision: Reject naive aggregate over candidate population. One statement with independent subqueries does not demonstrate scan/CPU reduction. Shared global-universe rewrite remains unproven and must preserve all filters and native branches.
required_negatives: zero listings versus zero candidates with global missing state
performance_claim: None; no plan, test or measurement executed for this proposal.
